Commentary: Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Rahmat Shah, no run, full delivery in line of the stumps, flicked to short mid-wicket
Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Rahmat Shah, no run, full on off, blocked watchfully towards covers
Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Rahmat Shah, no run, turning in from a back of a length, Rahmat hangs back and works it to short mid-wicket

Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Rahmat Shah, FOUR, sublime! Rahmat dances down the track, gets to the pitch of the tossed up delivery outside off and drives it beautifully past extra cover. The timing was perfect

Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Rahmat Shah, FOUR, 200 up for Afghanistan! Rahmat once again advances down the track, converts it into a half-volley outside off and creams the drive through extra cover to pick up back-to-back boundaries
Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Rahmat Shah, no run, quicker and flatter, Rahmat hangs back and works it towards mid-wicket
Taijul Islam to Ikram Alikhil, no run, Alikhil flicks this one to short mid-wicket

Taijul Islam to Ikram Alikhil, FOUR, shouts of catch it but it's safe! Alikhil uses his feet and hits it quite wide of the fielder at mid-on to pick up a boundary. Wasn't in complete control but still hit it decent enough
Taijul Islam to Ikram Alikhil, no run, tossed up on middle and leg, Alikhil sweeps it and short leg copes a blow
Taijul Islam to Ikram Alikhil, no run, tossed up on middle, Alikhil lunges in defence
Taijul Islam to Ikram Alikhil, no run, on a back of a length on leg-stump, Alikhil hangs back and blocks it to short leg
Taijul Islam to Ikram Alikhil, no run, slower through the air and on a back of a length on leg-stump, Alikhil camps back and tucks it to backward square leg
Mominul Haque, Left arm orthodox, comes into the attack
Mominul to Rahmat Shah, 1 run, Rahmat comes down the track and drives this one down to long-off
Mominul to Ikram Alikhil, no run, floated full delivery on off, Alikhil leans ahead and blocks it down the track
Mominul to Ikram Alikhil, 1 run, on the shorter side around off, Alikhil cuts it against the spin to sweeper cover
Mominul to Rahmat Shah, 1 run, tossed up full delivery on off, Rahmat drives it past extra cover

Mominul to Ikram Alikhil, 2 runs, on a back of a length around off, Alikhil rocks back and chops it through backward point. The fielder in the deep moves across to his right to cut it off. A couple results
Mominul to Ikram Alikhil, 1 run, on a length on off, Alikhil punches it through point. That's Stumps on Day 2
